name: Henrietta Whiston
source:
Edward’s second cousin, Henrietta is a frank, cheerful, and highly energetic woman.

She revels in the life of a socialite, and is also a leading philanthropist. She has a particular knack for coaxing people into giving donations while also making them feel good about themselves.

A certain case brought her and Edward close, and they eventually become bosom friends.

[From [url=http://studiopie.cafe24.com/eng/dear_edward] Official Website[/url]]
